summary: Approved iteration `registration-profile-consent`. Source review found the delivery satisfies the registration objectives: `User.firstName` and `User.lastName` are persisted via Prisma schema and migration; registration UI/actions capture and validate first/last name; first-time Google registration is gated by explicit profile consent; existing Google-linked login bypasses the first-time consent gate; rejected Google consent clears transient registration cookies and returns unauthenticated to sign-in. Fresh non-browser checks run successfully in this review: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs` with 4/4 passing, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Build pass is supported by prior delivery/test records and the human clarification that `npm run build` passed; I did not rerun build in this read-only review. Browser/Playwright verification was not run because this Codex task explicitly forbids browser execution; it remains pending and is not reported as passed.
